name: Matsuyama (Shikoku)
overview: A light, food/wandering-focused stopover between the Hiroshima and Beppu ferry legs, rather than a packed sightseeing day. Skipping Dogo Onsen bathing (already getting onsen time in Beppu/Yufuin) and treating the castle as "only if convenient."

recommendations.title: Ferry logistics
recommendations.summary: Hiroshima→Matsuyama ~70 min jet; Matsuyama→Beppu is a 2-leg journey.
recommendations.body: Hiroshima→Matsuyama: high-speed jet, about 70 minutes, roughly 8 daily departures — faster than the car ferry option (2.5 hrs). Matsuyama→Beppu is less direct: Matsuyama connects to Yawatahama port (about an hour by bus/train), then a separate ferry from Yawatahama to Beppu takes about 2 hours 50 minutes. Worth checking for an overnight sailing option on this leg specifically — some regional routes run overnight, which could mean sleeping through the crossing instead of losing daytime hours.

recommendations.title: Matsuyama Castle
recommendations.summary: Only if convenient — central, reachable by tram, ropeway up.
recommendations.body: Central, reachable by tram, with a ropeway/chairlift up to the keep. Rated "if convenient" rather than a priority.

recommendations.title: Dogo Onsen Honkan building
recommendations.summary: Striking bathhouse architecture — worth a look even while skipping the bath.
recommendations.body: Even skipping the bath itself, the building is a striking piece of architecture, often cited as inspiration for the bathhouse in Spirited Away — worth a quick look from outside if it fits the route.

recommendations.title: Okaido / Gintengai shopping arcades
recommendations.summary: Covered shopping streets, casual food and browsing between ferries.
recommendations.body: Covered shopping streets in central Matsuyama, good for casual food and browsing between ferries.

recommendations.title: Taruto
recommendations.summary: Local specialty, rolled sponge cake with sweet bean paste.
recommendations.body: Local specialty — rolled sponge cake with sweet bean paste, a good food souvenir.

recommendations.title: Shiroyama Park
recommendations.summary: The forested hill the castle sits on.
recommendations.body: The ropeway/chairlift ride up passes through wooded parkland, so even a "castle if convenient" visit doubles as a green-space walk.

recommendations.title: Mount Ishizuchi
recommendations.summary: Highest peak in Shikoku — likely not realistic on this transit day.
recommendations.body: Matsuyama is a gateway to Mount Ishizuchi, the highest peak in Shikoku, but it's a longer trip out of the city — likely not realistic given this is a ferry-to-ferry transit day. Flagged for a future, longer Shikoku visit instead.

openQuestions: Confirm exact Matsuyama → Yawatahama → Beppu connection timing once dates are locked, including whether an overnight sailing option exists
